layers.label: Visible light
layers.description: 617 nm, close to what the eye sees through a safe filter: the surface and its sunspots.

layers.label: Magnetic field
layers.description: The field along our line of sight: white points toward us, black away.

layers.label: 304 Å
layers.description: Extreme ultraviolet from helium at about 50,000 °C: the chromosphere and prominences.

layers.label: 171 Å
layers.description: Iron at about 600,000 °C: the quiet corona and its magnetic loops.

layers.label: 193 Å
layers.description: Iron at about 1 million °C: the corona, with dark coronal holes where the wind escapes.

layers.label: 131 Å
layers.description: Iron at about 10 million °C: the hottest flaring plasma.
